verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at render.com/llms.txt and a markdown docs index at render.com/docs.md, both returning 200 with agent-readable content. Docs pages are also served as .md files, and Render publishes a dedicated 'Coding agents' docs section plus 20+ official agent skills, so pointing an agent at its docs is well supported. Missing for 10: no evidence on the depth or completeness of the llms.txt content (e.g. an llms-full.txt variant) and no independent community corroboration of agents actually using these docs.
